rows.text: The red line closes the right lane; the arrow shows traffic merging left because of roadworks.

evidence: DM 10 luglio 2002, disciplinare § 3.1.3, fig. II.411/a: riduzione da due a una corsia presso un cantiere; fig. rows.text: The standard red-and-white striped barrier marks the boundary of a worksite and makes it visible.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 32 commi 1 e 4: barriera normale a strisce bianche e rosse e delimitazione dei cantieri. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The red and white stripes identify a standard barrier used to mark the limits of roadworks.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 32 commi 1 e 4: barriera normale a strisce bianche e rosse e delimitazione dei cantieri. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: If the closing mechanism fails, reflective red-and-white striped trestles can replace the barriers. A reflective red flag operated by the crossing attendant is also permitted, supplemented by a red lantern at night or in poor visibility.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 184 comma 1: sostituzione con cavalletti oppure con bandiera e lanterna manovrate dal custode; art. 189 commi 1-2: caratteristiche e uso di un solo cavalletto per lato solo se munito del prescritto disco rosso bordato di bianco. https://s3.eu-south-1.amazonaws.com/assets.h2o.cloudsinet/assets.cameri/uploads/2023/08/DPR-495-1992.pdf

rows.text: The striped barrier marks a worksite; it is not a no-parking sign for the roadside.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 32 commi 1 e 4: barriera normale a strisce bianche e rosse e delimitazione dei cantieri. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The striped barrier marks a worksite; it is not a dangerous-bend warning sign.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 32 commi 1 e 4: barriera normale a strisce bianche e rosse e delimitazione dei cantieri. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The striped barrier marks a worksite; it does not indicate an uneven road surface.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 32 commi 1 e 4: barriera normale a strisce bianche e rosse e delimitazione dei cantieri. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: In the temporary red-and-white version, the left-pointing chevrons show the diversion bending left.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 174 comma 3 lett. c, fig. II.466: delineatore bianco e nero per curva stretta; art. 32 comma 5, fig. II.393/a: barriera direzionale bianca e rossa con punte rivolte nella direzione della deviazione. https://s3.eu-south-1.amazonaws.com/assets.h2o.cloudsinet/assets.cameri/uploads/2023/08/DPR-495-1992.pdf

rows.text: The panel with white chevrons on black shows the course of a sharp bend or hairpin; the chevrons point along it.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 174 comma 3 lett. c, fig. II.466: delineatore bianco e nero per curva stretta; art. 33 comma 1 lett. b, fig. II.395: punte bianche su fondo rosso per deviazioni temporanee. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The panel highlights a sharp bend: the left-pointing chevrons help drivers recognize its course and pay attention.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 174 comma 3 lett. c, fig. II.466: delineatore bianco e nero per curva stretta; art. 33 comma 1 lett. b, fig. II.395: punte bianche su fondo rosso per deviazioni temporanee. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The black-and-white panel shows the course of a sharp bend; it does not mark a worksite boundary.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 174 comma 3 lett. c, fig. II.466: delineatore bianco e nero per curva stretta; art. 33 comma 1 lett. b, fig. II.395: punte bianche su fondo rosso per deviazioni temporanee. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The black-and-white panel shows the course of a sharp bend; it does not mark an obstacle projecting into the carriageway.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 174 comma 3 lett. c, fig. II.466: delineatore bianco e nero per curva stretta; art. 33 comma 1 lett. b, fig. II.395: punte bianche su fondo rosso per deviazioni temporanee. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The temporary diversion version has white chevrons on a red background, not a yellow one.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 174 comma 3 lett. c, fig. II.466: delineatore bianco e nero per curva stretta; art. 33 comma 1 lett. b, fig. II.395: punte bianche su fondo rosso per deviazioni temporanee. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The sign indicates a one-way road. When placed at the transition from two-way to one-way traffic, it marks the end of two-way traffic; it can also be repeated along the one-way section.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 96 comma 5: la fine del doppio senso è indicata dal senso unico frontale; art. 135 comma 25, fig. II.349: il segnale indica il senso unico ed è suscettibile di ripetizione. https://s3.eu-south-1.amazonaws.com/assets.h2o.cloudsinet/assets.cameri/uploads/2023/08/DPR-495-1992.pdf

rows.text: The frontal one-way sign indicates that traffic may use the road in the arrow’s direction; entry from the opposite end is prohibited.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 135 commi 24-25, figg. II.348-349: senso unico parallelo e frontale; art. 96 comma 5: fine del doppio senso; art. 114: precedenza nel senso unico alternato. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The frontal one-way sign is placed at the start of the one-way section and indicates the permitted direction.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 135 commi 24-25, figg. II.348-349: senso unico parallelo e frontale; art. 96 comma 5: fine del doppio senso; art. 114: precedenza nel senso unico alternato. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: It does not give priority over oncoming traffic: it indicates a one-way road, with entry prohibited from the opposite end.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 135 commi 24-25, figg. II.348-349: senso unico parallelo e frontale; art. 96 comma 5: fine del doppio senso; art. 114: precedenza nel senso unico alternato. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The arrow indicates the road’s one-way direction, not an obligation to continue straight or a ban on turning at intersections.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 135 commi 24-25, figg. II.348-349: senso unico parallelo e frontale; art. 96 comma 5: fine del doppio senso; art. 114: precedenza nel senso unico alternato. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: It does not indicate alternating traffic: the road is one-way, whereas alternating one-way traffic lets the two directions pass in turn.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 135 commi 24-25, figg. II.348-349: senso unico parallelo e frontale; art. 96 comma 5: fine del doppio senso; art. 114: precedenza nel senso unico alternato. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: Both are parallel one-way signs: the arrow shows the permitted direction on the intersecting road, left for A and right for B.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 135 commi 24-25, figg. II.348-349: senso unico parallelo e frontale; art. 96 comma 5: fine del doppio senso; art. 114: precedenza nel senso unico alternato. https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1e9c4-f10a-7ad0-a320-ba5c32f0c272
issues: 26117: Italian says the trestles delimit the level crossing, while the English, Chinese and Spanish say they close it. These are different actions; the explanation must state how the trestles replace the failed barriers, with equivalent wording in all four languages. DPR 495/1992 art. 189 addresses trestles for failure of the closing mechanisms.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1e9c8-626e-78e3-9826-e83642a01a64
issues: 26117: The categorical statement that failed barriers are replaced by trestles omits the expressly permitted alternative using an attendant-operated reflective red flag and red lantern at night or in poor visibility (DPR 495/1992 art. 184(1)); art. 189(2) also restricts use of a single trestle per side to one bearing the specified red disc. Qualify the example or include the relevant conditions.

26121: The cited art. 33(1)(b), fig. II.395 describes individual modular temporary curve delineators, whereas the pictured long multi-chevron panel corresponds in red and white to the directional barrier in art. 32(5), fig. II.393/a. Cite and check the provision for that pictured form.

26127: The one-way frontal sign may also repeat along a one-way section (art. 135(25)); it does not necessarily mean the immediately preceding section was two-way. Explain that it marks the end of two-way traffic when placed at that transition, without asserting a prior two-way section in every case.
